full_judgment: 7. It appears that the plaintiff claimed this possession which is supported by the P.W.2 and P.W.3 on the contrary the defendant claimed possession in the suit land having placed Ext-'Kha'; the recent Khatian has been prepared in the name of the defendant. This Ext-'Kha' has got its presumptive value of correctness unless the contrary is proved. The plaintiff did not adduced any single piece of evidence against the preparation of the recent record.
